# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A strong volume-weighted directional bias in the first 30 minutes predicts continuation after an opening-range breakout. The volume imbalance filter ensures institutional participation, while VWAP alignment and bullish EMA ribbon confirmation increase the probability of sustained momentum.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Go long at the close of the 3-minute bar when:  
1. Price breaks above the opening-range high (ORH)  
2. Volume of that bar ≥ 1.5× the average volume of the opening-range period (first 6 bars, 09:30-10:00 ET)  
3. Close of the bar is above VWAP  
4. EMA ribbon is bullish (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 on the 3-minute chart)  

**Exit:**  
- Initial stop: Chart-stop at the opening-range low (ORL)  
- Profit target 1 (TP1): 1.5R (where R = entry price - ORL)  
- Runner: Trail stop at 10% below the high-water mark after TP1 is hit  
- Time exit: 15:50 ET  

**Regime filters:** Only consider trades when VIX < 20, time is between 09:45-11:30 ET, and no major scheduled news (FOMC, CPI, NFP, mega-cap earnings) in the next 30 minutes.
